name: US long-haul and national fiber carriers — network map directory
source: Telecom Ramblings, USA Fiber Backbone Map Resources (https://www.telecomramblings.com/network-maps/usa-fiber-backbone-map-resources/)
note: A directory of where each carrier publishes its own route map — not route geometry, and not a statement that a carrier is present at any particular place. Telecom Ramblings maintains the index by hand and says so: 'because these are links to external sites, they may get broken from time to time.' Several entries predate the mergers that renamed the operator; nowPartOf records who actually answers the phone today. Use this to decide who to call about a corridor, then confirm the route with them. Licensed route geometry (GeoTel, FiberLocator, LandGate) lands in /api/fiber-proxy.js, never here.

carriers.name: Lumen Technologies
carriers.note: The two largest entries on the Telecom Ramblings list, CenturyLink and Level 3, are one company. Lumen is the largest US long-haul footprint and the most likely single answer to 'who is in this conduit'.

carriers.name: Zayo Group
carriers.note: Publishes an interactive route map. Dark fiber and wavelengths; the usual counterparty for a lateral build off a long-haul route.

carriers.name: AT&T
carriers.note: Telecom Ramblings lists international maps only — AT&T does not publish a US route map. Presence must be confirmed directly.

carriers.name: Verizon
carriers.note: International maps only on the published index.

carriers.name: Cogent Communications
carriers.note: International maps only. Cogent acquired the Sprint wireline business in 2023, so the two Sprint map links on the Telecom Ramblings list now describe Cogent plant.

carriers.name: Sprint (wireline)
carriers.note: Historic map, kept because the routes it shows are still in the ground. The operator is Cogent.

carriers.name: Uniti Group
carriers.note: Uniti and Windstream merged in 2025. Strong in the Southeast and mid-continent; a wholesale dark-fiber seller.

carriers.name: Telia Carrier
carriers.note: Rebranded Arelion in 2021. AS1299; a top-tier transit network with US long-haul routes.

carriers.name: Hurricane Electric
carriers.note: International maps only on the index; the he.net 3D map shows POPs rather than routes.

carriers.name: Spectrum Business (Charter)
carriers.note: The published map is dated 2014 and the footprint has grown a great deal since.

carriers.name: Mediacom
carriers.note: Telecom Ramblings marks this one 'seeking new map'.
